cohort: The study included 167 normal singleton pregnancies (12-42 weeks) for MV-Flow assessment and 42 fetuses scanned within 72 hours of delivery for NRDS prediction.
finding: Fetal pulmonary VIMV significantly increased with gestational age, and fetuses who developed NRDS had significantly lower VIMV, with each 1% increase in VIMV associated with a 65-73% reduction in NRDS risk.
cross-section timing: Across gestational ages from 12 to 42 weeks (for Part 1)
